Transparency: genuinely transparent background outside the square tile AND genuinely transparent apertures through its lattice. The openings are actual empty holes, not white paint, black filled polygons, gray checkerboard, or a floor behind them. Preserve fine native alpha edges without colored fringes.
Constraints: exactly one tile and no second object; no people; no lettering, labels, logos, watermark, ruler, or measuring marks. assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Use the FIRST attached image, a photograph of the actual production backdrop transparency, as the strict composition and geometry guide. The SECOND attached film frame confirms its intended colour and orientation; use only the view beyond the window from that frame, never its actors, window frame or room. Reconstruct only the rectangular painted space image within the first photo. Fill the complete wide landscape canvas with this one opaque background layer, about 1.6:1 width to height.
